- collect initial security/evidence requirements (SOC2/retention/KMS)

Thanks,

4) Mutual Action Plan & next steps (10 min)
5) Scheduling pilot/dev access & follow-ups (10 min)

Three final slot options (PT):
- Option A: Wed 28 Jul, 15:00–16:00 (preferred by Lina)
- Option B: Thu 29 Jul, 10:00–11:00
